name: transforming growth factor beta receptor 1

function.text: TGFBR1 encodes TGF-beta receptor type-1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Loeys-Dietz syndrome (autosomal dominant); multiple self-healing squamous epithelioma (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
